author: National Geographic
description:
Presented by National Geographic Society in partnership with @ROLEX. Expedition: Saving Our Seas follows the team behind the National Geographic and Rolex Perpetual Planet Ocean Expeditions, a multi-year, trailblazing exploration of our global Ocean. From the icy depths of the Antarctic to the tropical waters off the Seychelles these scientists and National Geographic Explorers set sail across all five ocean basins deploying new technology and partnering with local communities to find solutions to some of the biggest challenges facing our Ocean today. Narrated by Ocean conservationist Auliʻi Cravalho (Moana), the one-hour special is presented by the National Geographic Society in partnership with Rolex and produced by Offspring Films. Premieres Friday Nov. 13 on National Geographic and streams the next day on Disney+ and Hulu.

Rolex and The National Geographic Society are partnering on science-based expeditions to explore, study, and document change in the planet’s unique regions. #P
